newsitem.title: USA: Conceptronic to increase authorized shares.
newsitem.headline: Conceptronic to increase authorized shares.

text.p: Conceptronic Inc said Thursday it has proposed increasing the number of authorized shares of its common stock to 15 million from four million as part of its effort to raise $12 million in equity capital.
The proceeds would be used to finance possible acquisitions and investments. If approved by shareholders, the additional shares of Class A common stock would be sold at $3 a share.

Once the offering is launched, Rainer Bosselmann, currently the principal with Holding Capital Group Inc and former president of Jupiter National Inc, would join the company as chairman and chief executive. Conceptronic Chairman Garry Prime would remain as vice chairman and a company director.

Under the terms of the non-public offering, at least 3,333,333 shares of Class A common stock must be purchased. The shares of Class A common stock would be converted into shares of the company's common stock within six to eight months after the issuance.
Bosselmann has agreed to purchase 666,670 shares for $2 million, the company said.
